instruction: A bustling night market street: rows of food stalls under striped awnings and strings of glowing bulbs, hanging red lanterns, skewers and steamer baskets on the counters, crates of fruit, folding tables and stools, painted signboards, and bicycle carts. Lantern light pools over the lane while steam rises from the cooking stalls.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Asian Night Market. A bustling night market street: rows of food stalls under striped awnings and strings of glowing bulbs, hanging red lanterns, skewers and steamer baskets on the counters, crates of fruit, folding tables and stools, painted signboards, and bicycle carts. Lantern light pools over the lane while steam rises from the cooking stalls. Style: warm stylized. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
